title: Constant equation holds for the circuit witness
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, and let $w$ be an input assignment. Form the binary vector whose constant coordinate is $1$, whose input coordinates encode $w$, and whose gate coordinates encode the values of the gates on $w$. This vector satisfies the homogeneous quadratic equation that fixes the constant coordinate to $1$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit $C$ on $n$ input bits
